sections.description: Responsible-play / player-protection feature for WooCommerce competition sites. Auto-creates an editable Help & support page with an admin-managed services directory (ACF repeater under Theme Settings → Nera Features → Responsible Play). Signposts appear at checkout (clause 1.4, decoupled from the spend-limit plugin), in the My Account menu, as a sitewide footer strip, and as a toast after account closure (clause 1.5).
sections.installation: Install and activate the plugin. A Help and support page is created automatically with four default support organisations seeded into the directory. Edit them under Theme Settings → Nera Features → Responsible Play.
